definitions.cur: Revenue from operations, including excise duty at post-1-Feb-2026 rates
definitions.yoy: Revenue from operations, including excise duty at pre-1-Feb-2026 rates
definitions.qoq: Revenue from operations, including excise duty at pre- and post-1-Feb-2026 rates (rates changed mid-quarter)

pbt.label: PROFIT BEFORE TAX (6+7)
pbt.note: Q1 FY27 includes an exceptional gain of ₹405.88 crore on re-measuring the existing interest in Sproutlife (line 7, Note 4).

notes.excerpt: Consequently, Gross Revenue from sale of products and services and Excise duty for the quarters ended 30th June, 2026 and 31st March, 2026 reflects the impact of sharp increase in Excise duty and are not strictly comparable with those of the previous periods.

Accordingly, financial results of the Group and 'FMCG-Others' segment for the quarter ended 30th June, 2026 include those of Sproutlife from 1st April, 2026 and hence are not comparable with previous periods.
